publications.title: Zero-Shot Spatial Reasoning in Large Multimodal Foundation Models for Dynamic Robotics
publications.name: Dr. Marcus Vance
publications.caption: Figure 1: Real-time 3D bounding box prediction for zero-shot robotic manipulation tasks.
publications.abstract:
### Abstract

We present a unified multimodal foundation model capable of zero-shot 3D spatial grounding from monocular video feed. By embedding physical spatial priors directly into self-attention heads, our model predicts 6-DoF object poses at 60 FPS on edge accelerators.

publications.title: Sensifai-VLM: Real-Time Multimodal Video Understanding via Spatio-Temporal Token Selection
publications.name: Elena Rostova
publications.latexMathSample:
Our spatio-temporal token selector minimizes total video energy consumption while preserving multi-frame attention accuracy:
$$ \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} = \mathcal{L}_{\text{CE}}(\hat{y}, y) + \lambda_1 \cdot \sum_{l=1}^L \| M_l \|_1 + \lambda_2 \cdot \int_{0}^T \| \nabla \mathbf{z}(t) \|^2 dt $$
where cross-modal attention weights \( A_{ij} \) are computed dynamically across spatio-temporal video grids:
$$ A_{ij} = \frac{\exp\left( \frac{\mathbf{q}_i^T \mathbf{k}_j}{\sqrt{d_k}} + \gamma \cdot S(i,j) \right)}{\sum_{k} \exp\left( \frac{\mathbf{q}_i^T \mathbf{k}_k}{\sqrt{d_k}} + \gamma \cdot S(i,k) \right)} $$
publications.caption: Figure 4: Real-time power draw and FLOPs reduction on Jetson Orin vs Raspberry Pi 5.
publications.abstract:
### Abstract

Spatio-temporal redundancy in high-framerate video streams imposes intense computational barriers for video large language models. We introduce Sensifai-VLM, an architecture employing dynamic token selection over loss function \(\mathcal{L}_{\text{selection}} = \mathbb{E}_{v \sim \mathcal{V}}[\|f(v) - y\|^2 + \lambda \cdot \Omega(\theta)]\). Across Ego4D, Kinetics-700, and ActivityNet, Sensifai-VLM reduces latency by 3.8x while achieving state-of-the-art 88.4% top-1 accuracy.

publications.title: EdgeNet: 1-Bit Quantized Vision Backbones for Ultra-Low-Power Embedded Microcontrollers
publications.name: Elena Rostova
publications.caption: Figure 2: Memory footprint comparison across FP32, INT8, and EdgeNet 1-bit weights.
publications.abstract:
### Abstract

Deploying vision transformers to low-power embedded microcontrollers requires extreme quantization. EdgeNet demonstrates ternary and 1-bit weight quantization routines that retain 94.2% of FP32 ImageNet accuracy while reducing SRAM requirements to under 256KB.

publications.title: BioVision: Deep Spatio-Temporal Transformers for Automated Radiograph and ECG Diagnostic Anomaly Detection
publications.name: Javad Zolfaghari
publications.caption: Figure 1: Attention heatmaps identifying focal pulmonary opacities in high-resolution chest radiographs.
publications.abstract:
### Abstract

Clinical diagnostic workflows require high interpretability alongside state-of-the-art diagnostic sensitivity. BioVision combines multi-modal radiograph embeddings with temporal 12-lead ECG signal representations, achieving a 0.963 AUROC score across MIMIC-CXR and PhysioNet benchmarks.

publications.title: NeuroAudio: End-to-End Neural Diarization and Source Separation in Noisy Environments
publications.name: Javad Zolfaghari
publications.latexMathSample:
Complex-valued spectrogram reconstruction is governed by:
$$ \hat{S}(f,t) = M(f,t) \odot Y(f,t), \quad \text{where } M(f,t) \in [0, 1] + i [0, 1] $$
publications.caption: Figure 4: Full neural network architecture diagram for dual-path RNN attention.
publications.abstract:
### Abstract

Multi-speaker overlap in reverberant industrial environments creates severe degradation for automated speech recognition. NeuroAudio introduces complex time-frequency masking transformers that untangle multi-talker audio at sub-10ms latencies.

publications.title: Spatial-AudioNet: Multi-Microphone Spherical Harmonic Beamforming for Noise-Robust Diarization
publications.name: Alexander Chen
publications.caption: Figure 1: 3D spatial directivity pattern of spherical microphone array.
publications.abstract:
Spherical microphone arrays allow spatial filtering of ambient acoustic noise. Spatial-AudioNet processes multi-channel HOA signals to isolate overlapping speakers with less than 2.1% diarization error rate in reverberant meeting rooms.


  $$Y_n^m(\theta, \phi) = \sqrt{\frac{(2n+1)(n-m)!}{4\pi(n+m)!}} P_n^m(\cos\theta) e^{im\phi}$$

authors.name: Javad Zolfaghari
authors.headline: Founder & Lead AI Scientist at Sensifai Labs. Leading commercial and scientific innovations in real-time video, audio, and multimodal artificial intelligence.
authors.bio: Javad Zolfaghari is the Founder and CTO of Sensifai. His research focuses on real-time video understanding, spatio-temporal token selection for VLMs, and zero-shot neural audio processing. Under his leadership, Sensifai has pioneered ultra-low latency vision and perception systems deployed worldwide across cloud, edge, and mobile platforms.

authors.name: Dr. Sarah Jenkins
authors.headline: Pioneering neural speech separation, multi-talker diarization, and noisy acoustic signal processing.
authors.bio: Dr. Sarah Jenkins received her PhD from Stanford. At Sensifai, she leads the Audio AI lab developing NeuroAudio for real-time industrial noise cancellation, acoustic beamforming, and multi-channel speaker diarization.

authors.name: Dr. Marcus Vance
authors.headline: Senior Principal Researcher directing edge AI optimization, neural quantization, and zero-shot vision models.
authors.bio: Dr. Marcus Vance holds a PhD from MIT in Computer Science. His research interests encompass 1-bit quantization, embedded vision systems, and distributed multi-GPU training algorithms. He has published over 25 papers in top-tier conferences including CVPR, ICCV, and NeurIPS.

authors.name: Dr. Priya Sharma
authors.headline: Advancing clinical computer vision, ECG anomaly detection, and automated radiograph interpretation.
authors.bio: Dr. Priya Sharma leads the Medical AI & Healthcare division at Sensifai. She earned her PhD from Johns Hopkins University and has worked extensively on deep learning for radiological image analysis, real-time diagnostic decision support systems, and medical signal processing.

authors.name: Alexander Chen
authors.headline: Specialist in hardware acceleration, TensorRT compilation, and micro-controller neural networks.
authors.bio: Alexander Chen focuses on optimizing state-of-the-art vision models for ultra-constrained embedded hardware. His work includes compiler-level graph optimizations, weight quantization, and custom kernel development for NPU and RISC-V targets.

authors.name: Elena Rostova
authors.headline: Core contributor to Sensifai-VLM architecture and multi-camera spatial video reasoning.
authors.bio: Elena specializes in vision-language cross-attention mechanisms, spatio-temporal video Transformers, and dataset curation for large-scale video benchmark evaluation. Her recent focus is on self-supervised representation learning from untrimmed web video streams.
